thread:
Maya (CSM): ok team, QBR prep for E-Bridge next Wed — need final slide set + exec asks. quick sync?
Jared (Solutions): can do. i pulled last quarter's metrics, will paste condensed numbers into the deck.
Priya (AE): heads up — exec cares about renewal risk and usage deltas. i have 3 customer quotes we should surface.
Evan (Eng): any blockers from product side? i can add a short roadmap slide if needed.
Maya (CSM): thanks. primary asks: 1) health snapshot 2) onboarding status w/ blockers 3) top 3 risks + mitigation owner 4) 2 customer quotes 5) demo checklist. owners?
Jared (Solutions): i'll own health snapshot + demo checklist.
Priya (AE): i'll own renewal risk slide + quotes.
Lola (CS Ops): i'll collect onboarding statuses and compile the action tracker. can someone drop the current slide indices we should update?
Jared (Solutions): slide indices: 2 = exec summary, 5 = onboarding, 6 = risks, 7 = roadmap, 8 = quotes, 9 = demo plan.
Maya (CSM): perfect. target: internal dry run Monday 10am PT. calendar invite to follow. please upload slides to the QBR folder by Sunday EOD.
Calendar Bot: invite created: E-Bridge QBR dry run — Mon 10:00am PT. Attendees: Maya, Jared, Priya, Evan, Lola. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/ev/12345
Priya (AE): quick note — renewal risk #2 depends on a data-mapping bug; @Evan can you confirm ETA on fix?
Evan (Eng): looking into it. likely a patch next week but i need logs — @Jared can you share the failing payload?
Jared (Solutions): pasted payload in #eng-runtime earlier; will DM the link here.
Lola (CS Ops): building the action tracker now. format i use: Owner | Action | Due | Status. sample row: "Priya | finalize quotes & ask | Fri EOD | In progress"
Maya (CSM): love it. one more: include a slide with 'If renewal escalates' — fallback offers and pricing urgency. Priya please draft language.
Priya (AE): will draft.
Lola (CS Ops): uploaded draft action tracker: https://drive.redwood.com/qbr/ebridge/action-tracker.xlsx — pls add rows.
Maya (CSM): thanks. last request: capture one short customer success story (50-75 words) for the exec slide. Jared — can you grab one?
Jared (Solutions): on it.
Evan (Eng): FYI i'll join dry run but might drop early for sprint planning.
Maya (CSM): noted. thanks everyone — quick check: react with :thumbsup: when your part is done so Lola can mark complete. we should aim to have slides + tracker locked by Monday 8am PT for a 10am rehearse.
